en: Soldiers are yellow with a brown frons, blackish brown mandibular tips, a pale yellow labrum and a white front clypeus. The antennal-socket flaps and the first three antennal segments are brown, fading segment by segment toward the tip. Except for the darker rim of the pronotum, the remainder of the body is pale yellowish white in varying degrees, the abdomen being the palest.
soldier: 头部呈黄色，额区作褐色，上颚前端黑褐，上唇淡黄，前唇基白色；触角窝盖片与触角第一至第三节褐色，向端部逐节转淡。除前胸背板周缘颜色较深外，身体其余部分均呈深浅不一的淡黄白色，腹部尤为浅淡。
